description: Returns a tracked link's current settings, in the form update_share changes them: who can open it (the full allowed-domain and allowed-address lists), the email gate and its one-time code, whether a password is set (never the password), the end date, the copy lock, comments, the label, who the gate names, whether the sender is emailed on the first open, and the settings version. It reads one of this account's links and changes nothing. The answer includes the saved rules and the settings version that update_share takes as expected_settings_version.

share_id.description: The link's share id, slug (the part after /r/), or full address.

name: get_share
title: Read a tracked link's settings
